notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. One gear serves both pivots of both claws: the follower's is this one turned 120° about its axis, which keeps its tooth pattern and its hexes (claw_params.scad, THE FLIP). The page opens cut on its axis. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
